name: everydata
description: EveryData skill for structured public-data collection with live schemas, required-input checks and pagination limits.

interface.shortDescription: Collect structured public data with live schemas
interface.longDescription: EveryData discovers structured public-data actions and collects supported records. It keeps live schemas, required inputs, pagination limits and billing evidence explicit.
defaultPrompt: Find the current public-data capability for this platform and list the required inputs before making any paid request.
Retrieve one authorized page of public records using the largest useful page size within the live limit. Report unavailable fields explicitly.
Inspect this result for partial or empty data. Do not treat HTTP success as proof of a complete collection.
